requiredBehaviors.evidence: Claim-Safety forbids regulatory approval, certification or positive status unless explicitly established by content.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: do not use circle-check or badge-check to imply approval
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Lucide status rules explicitly prohibit circle-check, badge-check and similar positive-status icons from implying certification/approval without evidence.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: require text for any critical regulatory status
requiredBehaviors.evidence: criticalMeaning=true and regulatory/status semantics require an adjacent text label or status statement.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: encode certification through a positive Lucide status icon
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Positive status icons require evidence and cannot be used to make an unapproved product appear certified.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat medical or status icons as evidence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Provider contract states medical/science/status icons are communication, not regulatory or clinical evidence.
